visual_identity.core_identity: A squat heavy reptilian monster with eight sturdy legs and a fixed predatory stare associated with petrification.
visual_identity.silhouette: Low broad lizardlike body on eight short legs, thick tail, heavy head held forward.
visual_identity.head_features: Broad reptilian head with strong brow, wide jaw, small teeth, and intense forward-facing eyes.
visual_identity.body_shape: Stocky scaled reptile with exactly eight legs, low belly, and thick tapering tail.
visual_identity.surface: Large simple scales or armored skin plates used sparingly.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Exactly eight short reptilian walking legs support one low heavy body, with one thick tapering tail. No wings, arms, or additional limb pairs.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw one squat heavy reptile with one broad head, one low trunk, exactly eight short sturdy legs distributed under the body, and one thick tail. The belly stays close to the ground; do not collapse the anatomy into a four-legged lizard, snake, or dragon.

accuracy_checks: eight legs are countable or strongly readable
petrifying gaze identity remains visually readable from the creature itself

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
